data.name: desktop.status.stopped
data.value: The program is not taking orders.

data.name: desktop.attention.some
data.value: Open the admin pages. Something there needs you to deal with it.

data.name: desktop.minimised
data.value: The program keeps running and keeps taking orders. You get it back from the taskbar.

data.name: desktop.quit.body
data.value: Phones can no longer place orders afterwards.

data.name: desktop.error.portInUse
data.value: Choose a different port in the settings. Port {port} is already being used by another program.

data.name: desktop.error.dataFolderRepair
data.value: In the settings, click "Repair the setup". Nothing can be written into the folder {path}. Windows asks you once while it happens.

data.name: desktop.error.noNetwork
data.value: Connect the laptop to the WiFi the phones are on. The laptop is not on any network at the moment.

data.name: desktop.error.startFailed
data.value: The server could not be started. Quit the program and start it again. If that does not help, open the settings and choose "Repair the setup".

data.name: desktop.settings.portHelp
data.value: Change the port only when the program reports that it is taken. Afterwards no phone that is set up reaches the laptop any more, and you set them all up again.

data.name: desktop.settings.bindAddressHelp
data.value: Change this address only before the first phones are set up. Afterwards no phone that is set up reaches the laptop any more, and you set them all up again.

data.name: desktop.settings.addressLocked
data.value: Stop the server to change the port and the address. While it runs, the phones that are set up would no longer reach the laptop.

data.name: desktop.settings.dataFolderHelp
data.value: The database and the backup files are here.

data.name: desktop.settings.dataFolderLocked
data.value: Stop the server to change the data folder. While it runs, the program is writing into this folder.

data.name: desktop.settings.dataFolderRestart
data.value: Restart the program so the new folder takes effect. The database you have so far stays where it is.

data.name: desktop.settings.networkHelp
data.value: Choose the WiFi the phones are on. The laptop is on more than one network.

data.name: desktop.settings.repairSetupHelp
data.value: Use this when the phones cannot reach the laptop, or the program cannot write into its data folder. Windows asks you once while it happens.

data.name: desktop.settings.repairDeclined
data.value: In the Windows settings, open "Firewall & network protection" and allow this program the incoming connection on the private network. For the data folder you need somebody who can confirm the question Windows asks.

data.name: desktop.firstRun.body
data.value: Confirm the question Windows asks. The program allows access from the network and creates its data folder.

data.name: desktop.firstRun.declined
data.value: The program runs anyway. If the phones cannot reach the laptop later, do this in the settings under "Repair the setup".
